developed_by: Center of Applied Internet Data Analysis (CAIDA)
attack_types: DDoS (SYN flood, ICMP flood, HTTP flood)
description: Authentic packet traces from the Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attack on August 4, 2007. Anonymized CryptoPAn prefix-preserving pcap traces covering attack onset, SYN flood, ICMP flood, and volumetric saturation.
